workflow_steps.command: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m money_model_architect.cli session start --business-dir <business_dir> --user-message "what's the difference between an attraction offer and an upsell in this situation?"

PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m money_model_architect.cli search --business-dir <business_dir> --source-need-json '{"intent":"comparison_evidence","layers":["offers"],"focus_terms":["attraction offer","front-end offer","lead generation offer"],"user_turn":"what's the difference between an attraction offer and an upsell in this situation?","query_variants":["what is an attraction offer purpose","attraction offer role in money model","front-end offer vs core offer"]}' --top-k 5

PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m money_model_architect.cli search --business-dir <business_dir> --source-need-json '{"intent":"comparison_evidence","layers":["upsells"],"focus_terms":["upsell","post-sale add-on","increase order value"],"user_turn":"what's the difference between an attraction offer and an upsell in this situation?","query_variants":["what is an upsell purpose","upsell role after core offer purchase","increasing average order value with upsells"]}' --top-k 5
PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m money_model_architect.cli session finish --business-dir <business_dir> --record-json turn_record_022.json
